newsitem.title: JAPAN: Comson postpones payment of notes for two weeks.
newsitem.headline: Comson postpones payment of notes for two weeks.

text.p: Machinery manufacturer Comson Corp said on Friday that it has postponed its settlement of promissory notes worth 80 million yen until August 15.
The notes were due on Thursday and Friday.
Comson president Toshimi Matsuda told a news conference that the company would try to hammer out some kind of agreement with lenders during the next two weeks.
He said the company had either paid back or received agreement from lenders to postpone repayment on a total of 300 million yen worth of promissory notes due by Thursday.
The company said on Wednesday that it was having trouble raising 100 million yen to cover promissory notes due on Thursday.
